MATCH (o:Owner)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document)
WHERE o.birth_date IS NOT NULL
WITH o,
     CASE WHEN o.death_date IS NULL THEN 2026 ELSE CAST(SPLIT(o.death_date, '/')[0] AS INT64) END AS ref_year,
     CASE WHEN o.death_date IS NULL THEN 10 ELSE CAST(SPLIT(o.death_date, '/')[1] AS INT64) END AS ref_month,
     CASE WHEN o.death_date IS NULL THEN 15 ELSE CAST(SPLIT(o.death_date, '/')[2] AS INT64) END AS ref_day,
     CAST(SPLIT(o.birth_date, '/')[0] AS INT64) AS birth_year,
     CAST(SPLIT(o.birth_date, '/')[1] AS INT64) AS birth_month,
     CAST(SPLIT(o.birth_date, '/')[2] AS INT64) AS birth_day
WITH o.nationality AS nationality,
     ref_year - birth_year - CASE WHEN birth_month > ref_month OR (birth_month = ref_month AND birth_day > ref_day) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS age
RETURN nationality AS col1, MIN(age) AS col2

MATCH (o:Owner)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document)
WHERE o.birth_date IS NOT NULL
WITH o.nationality AS nationality,
     CAST(REGEXP_EXTRACT(o.birth_date, '([0-9]{4})$', 1) AS INT64) AS birth_year,
     CASE
       WHEN REGEXP_MATCHES(o.birth_date, '^[0-9]{4}/') THEN CAST(REGEXP_EXTRACT(o.birth_date, '^[0-9]{4}/([0-9]{1,2})/', 1) AS INT64)
       WHEN REGEXP_MATCHES(o.birth_date, '^January') THEN 1
       WHEN REGEXP_MATCHES(o.birth_date, '^February') THEN 2
       WHEN REGEXP_MATCHES(o.birth_date, '^March') THEN 3
       WHEN REGEXP_MATCHES(o.birth_date, '^April') THEN 4
       WHEN REGEXP_MATCHES(o.birth_date, '^May') THEN 5
       WHEN REGEXP_MATCHES(o.birth_date, '^June') THEN 6
       WHEN REGEXP_MATCHES(o.birth_date, '^July') THEN 7
       WHEN REGEXP_MATCHES(o.birth_date, '^August') THEN 8
       WHEN REGEXP_MATCHES(o.birth_date, '^September') THEN 9
       WHEN REGEXP_MATCHES(o.birth_date, '^October') THEN 10
       WHEN REGEXP_MATCHES(o.birth_date, '^November') THEN 11
       WHEN REGEXP_MATCHES(o.birth_date, '^December') THEN 12
     END AS birth_month,
     CAST(CASE
       WHEN REGEXP_MATCHES(o.birth_date, '^[0-9]{4}/') THEN REGEXP_EXTRACT(o.birth_date, '^[0-9]{4}/[0-9]{1,2}/([0-9]{1,2})', 1)
       ELSE REGEXP_EXTRACT(o.birth_date, '^[A-Za-z]+ ([0-9]{1,2}),', 1)
     END AS INT64) AS birth_day
WITH nationality,
     2026 - birth_year - CASE WHEN birth_month > 10 OR (birth_month = 10 AND birth_day > 15) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS age
RETURN nationality AS col1, MIN(age) AS col2
